era.title: Galactic Coexistence
era.subtitle: Civilizations learn to share the galaxy through rights, memory, translation, and stewardship
era.description: This era marks the rise of mature galactic coexistence through multi-species councils, shared rights for many forms of mind, perception-level translation, shared cities, protected stars, galactic memory archives, and new ethics for life, intelligence, and cosmic history.
